task_prompt: You are given the following quantum programming task. Write a Qiskit program that prepares an arbitrary state with amplitudes proportional to [0.25, 0.42, 0.97, 0.32] using StatePreparation, then verifies the prepared statevector matches the normalized target. Give one complete script that runs end-to-end on its own and prints the outcome.
